summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and all consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, and sub-route-reports, which also used it) in one monorepo PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so there is no registry release/version bump or dependency update needed. libs-platform-kit has no reference to billingUrl and doesn't depend on shared-contracts, so no change/PR made for PLAT-102-4. Single PR rather than ordered PRs because inlining makes the lib and apps land atomically.
